Beacon Redesign Plan (2026-10-16) · Current-State Verification Table ​

Verification target: docs/design/redesign-plan-2026-10-16.md (external design draft, commit f77b0d1) Verification date: 2026-10-16

Nature statement: the design draft under verification is an external suggestion, not a fact of this repository. The 「已有实现 / 此前设计」 (existing implementations / prior designs) it mentions are all treated as undocumented until verified; this table is the verification record made before any work starts.

The meaning of "Not found": it only means the thing was never written down in this repository's code or documentation; it cannot prove it was never designed. For any item marked "Not found", if a design source is later found, it should be backfilled into this table rather than being set up again as a brand-new requirement.

1. Verification conventions ​

ClassificationMeaningNotation
ImplementedThe code exists and in-repo documentation already records itGive file:line + documentation source
Partially implementedThe claim can be split and is labeled item by itemImplemented parts get file:line; non-implemented parts are written as "Not found"
Exists but undocumentedThe code exists but in-repo documentation never recorded it (including cases where docs state only acceptance criteria, not the mechanism)Give file:line and mark it as needing backfill
Not foundNeither code nor documentation has itWrite "Not found"; if the repo has counter-records or deferral records, attach the source and the design draft's original text

Items that are "implemented in part" are always written out item by item; vague conclusions like 「大致符合」 ("roughly matches") are not used.

B11Six concept kinds: State / Event / Command / Operation / Operation Result / PreferencePartially implementedImplemented: State=WidgetState.cs:4, Event=src/Beacon.Core/Events/Events.cs:6-22 (5 records), Command=src/Beacon.Core/Models/ActionModels.cs:6-15, Operation Result=ActionModels.cs:28. B12The UI thread is never blocked by background network requestsImplementedsrc/Beacon.Core/Abstractions/IEventBus.cs:12-22 (IUiDispatcher + SubscribeOnUi marshaling); src/Beacon.Core/Services/DispatchGuard.cs:14 as the last line of defense for UI dispatch exceptions
